meta.title: Pirate mode
meta.description: Enables pirate sidebar and conversation-home marks, an ocean background, and a first-mate persona by default. Locale packs, status phrases and persona text are stored by language id under content/, so languages can be added or removed freely. User logo overrides, custom instructions and music settings remain untouched.

ui.hint: Brand marks, pirate wording, status phrases and persona prompts apply live after saving.
ui.masterHint: Turning off restores native marks and wording and disables the first-mate prompt; if a pirate language is active, it switches back to the fallback language.
ui.brandHint: Sidebar mark, conversation-home mark and wordmark; each can be pirate or original.
ui.messagesHint: Pirate vocabulary shown in the DSH interface for this language.
ui.phrasesHint: Pirate one-liners for the running-status line, one per line.
ui.personaHint: First-mate system prompt injected into the agent. Saves hot-reload immediately; leave blank to skip injection for this language.
ui.langSectionHint: Pick a language to edit below. Switching this selector does not change the active interface language.
ui.noLocalePackForLang: No interface wording pack configured for this language.
ui.noLanguages: No language content is currently enabled.
ui.oceanNote: The ocean background is configured separately at the bottom-right of the interface.
